blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States First Lady Melania Trump was noticeably absent from a highly anticipated gathering of first spouses and child protection advocates in Manila on Monday, opting instead to deliver a recorded video message at an event hosted by Philippine First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos. Neither Philippine nor US authorities provided an explanation for her absence. Her husband, US President Donald Trump, is expected to arrive in Manila later today (Nov. 17) to attend the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and make a state visit to the Philippines.
